We need to propose a retrosynthesis route (max 3 steps) to target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

So target is a sulfonamide linking a tolyl (para methyl phenyl) to a phenyl with a cinnamamide (trans double bond) attached to an aniline (para amino). Actually structure: p-methyl phenyl-sulfonyl attached to phenyl which has a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (para amino). So overall three fragments: tolyl sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonylating agent), the second phenyl (aryl sulfonyl) with a side chain (cinnamamide). The side chain is an amide linking to an aniline.

We need commercially available precursors, total cost < $9999. We have some data: the aniline with amide (O=C(C=C)Nc1ccc(N)cc1) is available at price 399 (APPCHEM) or 140 for 250 mg. Good.

We also need sulfonyl chloride: p-tolylsulfonyl chloride (CH3C6H4SO2Cl). Search? Let's try search catalog for that.
